comparative.text: [The Umbelliferie, The Berberidaceis And] Conium does not act very prominently on the chest. However, we find it useful in consumptives when they find it impossible to expec- torate the sputum; they must swallow it again. It is especially use- ful for tormenting night cough, from tickling as from a dry spot in the larynx, which is relieved as soon as the patient sits up in bed. There is scarcely any cough during the day.
